correctness.rationale: ADMISSION_DEFECT: Lemma B inverts the cited black boxes. Einstein Theorem 2 assumes G_v virtually compact special to conclude long peripherally-finite fillings are hyperbolic virtually special; the draft assumes fillings-special to conclude G_v special, with no cited converse. Groves-Manning Theorem A requires proper cocompact cubulation plus Assumptions 1.1-1.2, while (i) assumes only weakly relatively geometric action, so hypotheses do not match. The claimed equivalence between malnormalizability and fillings-special is false. The final promotion via MSQT/hierarchy cites theorems in the wrong direction. Hence the essential rigid-vertex inference is unproved.

value.rationale: Even if true, the headline is a conditional repackaging of black boxes plus routine combination: QH specialness is standard, rigid specialness is assumed via (i)-(ii) encoding the conclusions of the cited theorems, and Lemma C is direct QVH closure applied to the finite JSJ graph. No decision when (i)-(ii) hold, no effective index, construction, converse, or new criterion is given; the dichotomy is only the logical contrapositive. This is a textbook corollary assembly with no independently retrievable exact fact.
